subject.title: feat(cloud-workers): session placement, dispatch, and worker turn routing

question: Should this milestone land only after pre-provision failures are recoverable and the persisted placement upgrade/restart path has real end-to-end proof?
rationale: The PR creates a durable authority for session execution ownership; accepting a terminal early-failure path or unproven restart behavior could make sessions unavailable or require database-level intervention.

options.title: Require recovery proof
options.body: Fix early-failure rollback, add focused timeout and restart coverage, rebase cleanly, and provide real end-to-end dispatch evidence before merge.

options.title: Accept manual recovery
options.body: Land while explicitly accepting that some failed dispatches may require operator or database intervention.

options.title: Pause the milestone
options.body: Keep the canonical cloud-workers issue open but pause or replace this branch if the failure-safe transition cannot be made narrow and auditable.

recommendation.title: Require recovery proof
recommendation.body: Fix early-failure rollback, add focused timeout and restart coverage, rebase cleanly, and provide real end-to-end dispatch evidence before merge.
